title: The macro gain is a normalization artifact

statements.text: Causal emergence depends on imposing a uniform distribution over microstates for micro EI and, separately, a uniform distribution over macrostates for macro EI, though the micro uniform distribution yields a non-uniform one over macrostates.

sources.quote: we insist on the uniform distribution over microstates when calculating microscopic EI, and we also insist on the uniform distribution over macrostates when calculating macroscopic EI
such as requiring a uniform distribution of interventions, which some have criticized
